expected.msg: restrict requires a pointer or reference ('int' is invalid)
pointer to function type 'void (void)' may not be 'restrict' qualified
due to lvalue conversion of the controlling expression, association of type 'int *restrict' will never be selected because it is qualified
initializing 'int **' with an expression of type 'int *restrict *restrict' discards qualifiers
initializing 'int **restrict' with an expression of type 'int *restrict *restrict' discards qualifiers
constexpr variable cannot have type 'int *const restrict'
